initial_compromise: Token replay from an unmanaged device
summary: A long-lived service token was accepted from an unbound device. Its connected OAuth application carried broader permissions than the order workflow required, allowing the actor to pivot into payment and customer data systems.

contributing_factors.title: Credential was not device-bound
contributing_factors.detail: The service token was replayed from an unfamiliar endpoint without a device binding check.

contributing_factors.title: OAuth grant exceeded app needs
contributing_factors.detail: oauth-77 held payments:admin although the integration only needs order processing access.

contributing_factors.title: No step-up authentication
contributing_factors.detail: The high-impact OAuth grant proceeded without a recent MFA challenge.

breakpoints.reason: Stops the active session before it can pivot into connected applications.
Constrains future access if the service credential is compromised again.
